items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 5:1
items.html: The light of Hochma is the light that is extended to the emanated being in the first expansion, which is the entirety of the vitality and the self of the emanated being. (Inner Light, Part 1, Chapter 1, Item 50)
